page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top; page number at top left. Marginal ink marks and specks at left and right edges are not text. Headings centred: "EX CANTICO ZACHARIÆ", "EX CANTICO MARIÆ", "EX CANTICO SIMEONIS". Running text in paragraphs, no notes in the margins.

main_text.head: EX CANTICO ZACHARIÆ,
main_text.p: Benedicta sis Domina, & mater Dei mei Israël, qui per te visitavit & fecit redemptionem plebis suæ. Et erexit unicornu salutaris castitatis tuæ in domo David. Salutem ex inimicis præsta virginum virgo, & de manu omnium, qui nos oderunt, pacem tribue. Et fac misericordiam pro parentibus & nobis, &c. Per viscera multitudinis misericordiæ tuæ, visita nos stella matutina oriens ex alto. Illumina tenebras sedentium in morte, &c.
main_text.head: EX CANTICO MARIÆ
main_text.p: Magnificat anima mea Dominam Mariam. A Solis ortu usque ad occasum, laudabile nomen Mariæ. Rënuit consolavi anima mea: memor fui Mariæ, & delectata exercitata sum, & defecit spiritus meus. Ideo dilexi Mariam, super aurum & topazion. Accedite ad Mariam, & illuminamini, & facies vestræ non confundantur, &c.
main_text.head: EX CANTICO SIMEONIS,
main_text.p: Nunc dimittis ancillam Mariæ Domine in pace, quia viderunt oculi mei Salutare Mariæ, quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum. Lumen ad revelationem gentium, & gloriam plebis tuæ Israël.

page.notes: Printed "Mariam" and "Mariæ" as in the scan; some words near the edges are faint. Line-initial "Nunc" carries a decorative initial. The final signature mark "£X" at lower right is a catchword-like mark, not transcribed.
